footer: RoadSoft Import Application — Client IT Specification — v2.1.15
subtitle: IT Specification — Version 2.1.15
purpose: Automated synchronization of digital tachograph files (`.ddd`, `.esm`) to the RoadSoft cloud platform
privileges_value: No administrator or root privileges required
important_peruser: RoadSoft installs per user account by default (AppData\Local\Programs), but the installation directory can be changed during setup. Note that user data (configuration, logs) is always stored per user account in AppData\Roaming.
note_hidden: The `AppData` folder is hidden by default in Windows. Enable "Show hidden files" in File Explorer to access it.
file_processing_intro: After synchronization, processed files are relocated based on the result. Each `.ddd`/`.esm` file is moved individually, keeping its relative path under `Archived/` or `Failed/`; the folder it came from stays where it is. Before uploading, the application asks the RoadSoft platform which files it already holds or has permanently rejected: files it already holds are moved to `Archived/` without being uploaded again, files it has rejected are moved to `Failed/`. A file that could not be sent stays in the folder and is retried on the next synchronization. Corrupted `.zip` archives are moved to `Failed/` during the initial scan.
archived_contents: Files uploaded to the RoadSoft platform, and files the platform already held
failed_contents: Files the RoadSoft platform permanently rejected, and corrupted archives. A file that could not be sent (network or server error) stays in the sync folder and is retried on the next synchronization.
note_file_processing: Both folders are created automatically inside the selected sync folder. They are excluded from future scans, so files placed there will not be re-processed.
note_zip_trash: After a `.zip` archive is successfully extracted, the original `.zip` file is automatically moved to the OS recycle bin and can be restored from there if needed.
autolaunch: Auto-launch on system startup is supported and configurable within the application
tray: Minimize to system tray is supported (optional)
